_how_to: Copy to result.json and fill in one entry per game played, in order. 'actions' = all 20 draft actions (bans and picks) in the order they were locked in, as champion names (use null for a missed ban). 'blue_first' = true if blue side picked first, false if red did (2026 First Selection). Run: .venv/Scripts/python scripts/score_final.py --lock reports/forecast_lock_2026-11-14 --result reports/forecast_lock_2026-11-14/result.json
